locations.title: Turtle Rock
locations.description:
**Level:** 8

**Required:** Defeat [Turtle Rock](#loc=56543) (Mini-Boss)

Turtle Rock is both the name of this dungeon and the creature block its entrance. Defeat the mini-boss to reveal the opening to the Turtle Rock dungeon.

locations.title: Color Dungeon
locations.description:
**Level:** 0

**Required:** None

Unlike other dungeons where the goal is to find instruments to wake the Wind Fish, the Color Dungeon rewards you with the option to change your tunic and increase one of your stats.

Anytime you want to change your tunic color (Red, Blue, or Green), you can return to the Color Dungeon and talk to the [Fairy Queen](#loc=56509).

**Reward:** Blue Tunic (increased defense) or Red Tunic (increased attack)

locations.title: Angler's Tunnel
locations.description:
**Level:** 4

**Required:** Angler Key

After completing the Key Cavern, you can meet Marin on the Toronbo Shores, south of Mabe Village. Link and Marin have a nice moment together, and then Marin becomes a temporary companion! Escort Marin to the Animal Village, where she can wake up the Sleeping Walrus. With the Walrus out of the way, Link can continue into the Yarna Desert and fight [Lanmola](#loc=56407). Defeat the boss to receive the Angler Key. The lock is south of the dungeon entrance, on the raised platform. Use the Angler key on the lock to lower the water level and reveal the Angler's Tunnel entrance.

locations.title: Eagle's Tower
locations.description:
**Level:** 7

**Required:** Bird Key

After completing the Key Cavern, you'll get access to the [Dream Shrine](#loc=56269) and the Ocarina. Afterwards, head south of the Ukuku Prairie to the Pothole Fields and Signpost Maze. Follow the directions of the signs until you find Mamu. Mamu will teach you the Frog's Song of Soul in exchange for 300 rupees. With a new song for your Ocarina, head back to Mabe Village. You may have noticed a bird-shaped weather vein in town, where Marin typically hangs out and sings. Push the bird statue to reveal stairs, which lead you to some rooster bones. Play the Frog's Song of Soul to revive the rooster. Carrying the rooster makes Link fly!

With your zombie rooster in tow, make your way to the [Hen House](#loc=53827) in the Tal Tal Mountain Range. Before reaching the [Hen House](#loc=53827), stop by a cave directly south of the [Hen House](#loc=53827) and use the rooster to fly over the chasm to finally pick up the Bird Key. The dungeon's lock is to the left of the cave entrance, behind some boulders.

This is easily the most confusing dungeon in the game. The main objective is to throw the iron ball at all four cracked pillars. This is easier said than done. It is _highly_ recommended to follow a video walkthrough to prevent getting lost and endlessly backtracking through the dungeon.

locations.title: Bottle Grotto
locations.description:
**Level:** 2

**Requires:** BowWow

Shortly after completing the [Tail Cave](#loc=53772), Link returns to Mabe Village to find that Moblins have kidnapped BowWow. Rescue BowWow in the Moblin Cave and return him to [Madam MeowMeow](#loc=53793). In return, you can take BowWow for a walk into the Goponga Swamp, where he can eat the Goponga Flowers blocking the dungeon entrance.

locations.title: Tail Cave
locations.description:
**Level:** 1

**Required:** Tail Key

To unlock this dungeon, you must retrieve the Tail Key from the Mysterious Forest. However, when you enter the forest, a raccoon will meddle with the map, ensuring you get lost and never find the key.

While you stumble around the Mysterious Forest, you will eventually find a hollow trunk that leads into a cave. Exit out the other side of the cave and pick up the Sleepy Toadstool on the ground. Find the [Witch's Hut](#loc=53809) and trade the Sleepy Toadstool for Magic Powder. Return to the Mysterious Forest and throw the Magic Powder at the raccoon. Now, you can navigate the north side of the Mysterious Forest and find the Tail Key in a chest.

locations.title: Key Cavern
locations.description:
**Level:** 3

**Required:** Slime Key

Prince Richard currently has the Slime Key needed to open the Key Cavern. He can be found at [Richard's Villa](#loc=53813), where he has taken up residence since fleeing Kanalet Castle. He agrees to give you the Slime Key in exchange for five Golden Leaves from Kanalet Castle.

The bridge to Kanalet Castle is being guard by Kiki. If you give [Bananas](#loc=53834) to Kiki, he'll let you pass.

locations.title: Face Shrine
locations.description:
**Level:** 6

**Required:** Face Key, Bow & Arrow

You probably already have the bow at this point in the game, but if not, head to the [Mabe Village Shop](#loc=53799) and purchase a bow for 980 rupees.

Next, you need to find the Face Key to unlock the gate to the dungeon. North of the Face Shrine, you can find the Ancient Ruins. The Ancient Ruins are filled with Armos, stone enemies that come alive when Link touches them. The easiest method to defeat an Armos is drop a bomb, and just as the bomb starts flashing red, touch the Armos, and run away. If you time it correctly, the bomb will explode and kill the Armos just as it wakes up. You only need to defeat the Armos that block your path to the Ancient Ruins temple. 

Inside the temple, you will find a mini-boss: the Armos Knight. The Armos Knight will chase you around the room, jumping and slamming the ground to try and stun Link. Use the Roc's Feather to jump just as the Armos Knight starts to fall to avoid the stun attack. As you attack the Armos Knight, his weapons and armor will fall off and he'll become easier and easier to attack. When the Armos Knight is finally defeated, pick up the Face Key.

locations.title: Catfish's Maw
locations.description:
**Level:** 5

**Required:** Flippers from [Angler's Tunnel](#loc=53769)

To enter Catfish's Maw, swim in Martha's Bay to the southeast corner of the giant stone catfish, near the cluster of rocks. Dive underwater to enter a 2D view where you can now swim through a hidden underwater path. When you surface on the other side, Link will be in the center of the rock cluster near the entrance of Catfish's Maw.

locations.title: Wind Fish's Egg
locations.description:
**Level:** 9

**Required:** [Magnifying Glass](#loc=53844)

In order to navigate the Wind Fish Egg, you need to use the [Magnifying Glass](#loc=53844) to read the mysterious book at the [Mabe Village Library](#loc=53852). The [Magnifying Glass](#loc=53844) is the final item in the Trading Sequence quest.

The pattern to navigate the Wind Fish is randomized for each game save, so it's important to learn the pattern from the library book. Write it down or take a screenshot to reference later.

Outside the Wind Fish Egg, use the Ocarina to play the Ballad of the Wind Fish. Proceed to the final dungeon and the final boss fight!

locations.title: Fairy Bottle
locations.description:
**Requires**: Completion of Face Shrine

An empty bottle that can be used to hold a fairy for healing.

Complete 10 [Chamber Dungeon](#loc=53810) challenges to earn this item.

locations.description:
An empty bottle that can be used to hold a fairy for healing.

Can be fished out of the bottom of the pond during the [Fishing Pond](#loc=53806) minigame. It's in the lower left corner of the pond, partially covered by grass.

locations.title: Fairy Bottle
locations.description:
An empty bottle that can be used to hold a fairy for healing.

Shortly after you complete the [Angler's Tunnel](#loc=53769) dungeon, a pink ghost will begin to follow you around as you explore Koholint Island. Guide the ghost to the [Ghost's House](#loc=53814) and then to its grave. In return, the ghost will give you a fairy bottle.

locations.description: Use a bomb to destroyed the cracked wall. The fairy fountain is inside the cave.

locations.title: Fairy Queen
locations.description:
This is a unique Fairy Fountain, presided over by the Fairy Queen.

The Fairy Queen offers Link a choice: Powerful Red Mail (increased attack) or Sturdy Blue Mail (increased defense). This isn't a permanent change; you can return to the Fairy Queen and change your tunic whenever you want.

locations.title: Seashell Mansion
locations.description:
Find Secret Seashells hidden around Koholint Island and trade them in for rewards!

**Rewards:**
- 5 — Heart Piece
- 15 — Seashell Sensor
- 30 — Chamber Stone
- 40 — Koholint Sword
- 50 — Chamber Dungeon Modifier

locations.title: Dream Shrine
locations.description: The Dream Shrine is available after completing the Key Cavern. Enter the house and go to bed. While you sleep, you are transported to a with a bunch of Arm-Mimics. Use the Pegasus Boots to charge forward and kill all the Arm-Mimics in a line, without breaking any of the floor tiles. At the center of the room you can find 100 rupees and the Ocarina.

locations.title: Mad Batter
locations.description:
**Required:** Power Bracelet

Lift the boulder to reveal the entrance to Mad Batter’s altar. Sprinkle Magic Powder to awaken the Mad Hatter. In return, he'll "curse" you with an increased carry capacity for magic powder.

locations.title: Mad Batter
locations.description:
**Required:** Roc's Feather, Pegasus Boots, Flippers

Clear the grass near the altar entrance using either bomb or boomerang, then long jump (Roc's Feather + Pegasus Boots) across the holes in the ground. Go down the stairs and use the Flippers to cross the underground water. On the other side of the water is a staircase, use it to return above ground and walk straight to reach a third stairwell—this will finally lead you to the Mad Batter. Sprinkle Magic Powder on the altar to wake the Mad Batter. In return, he'll "curse" you with an increased carry capacity for bombs.

locations.title: Mad Batter
locations.description:
**Required:** Hookshot, Power Bracelet

Lift the boulder to reveal a stairwell. Sprinkle Magic Powder on the altar to wake the Mad Batter. In return, he'll "curse" you with an increased carry capacity for arrows.

locations.title: Trendy Game
locations.description:
_10 rupees per game_

You'll be able to access the Trendy Game after finding Link's sword and clearing away the tall grass. New prizes will be available every time you complete a new dungeon. Keep in mind, new items won't appear until you've won the old ones. Below is the chronological appearance of special prizes:

1: **Yoshi Doll** (**Trading Sequence #1**) - After first visit to the Mysterious Forest

2: **Heart Piece #1** - Exit & enter the shop after obtaining the **Yoshi Doll**

3 : **Secret Seashell #1** - Exit & enter the shop after obtaining **Heart Piece #1**

4: **CiaoCiao Figure** - Exit & enter the shop after obtaining **Heart Piece #1** & giving the **Ribbon** to CiaoCiao for **Trading Sequence #3**

5: **Goomba Figure** - Completion of **Tail Cave**

6: **Spiny Figure** - Completion of **Bottle Grotto**

7: **Chamber Stone #1** - Completion of **Bottle Grotto**

8: **Heart Piece #2** - Completion of **Key Cavern**

9: **Boo Figure** - Completion of **Key Cavern**

10: **Secret Seashell #2** - Completion of **Angler's Tunnel**

11: **Cheep Cheep Figure** - Completion of **Angler's Tunnel**

12: **Blooper Figure** - Completion of **Catfish's Maw**

13: **Shy Guy Figure** - Completion of **Face Shrine**

14: **Piranha Plant Figure** - Completion of **Eagle's Tower**

15: **Pokey Figure** - Completion of **Turtle Rock**

16: **BowWow Figure** - Completing the game (beating **Nightmare** & saving after the credits roll; star will be next to the save file)

17: **Chamber Stone #2** - After collecting all 10 Figures the **Trendy Gamester** will give Link the second **Chamber Stone**

**Note**: After collecting all 10 Figures the cost of playing the game will be cut in half to 5 Rupees.

locations.title: Fishing Pond
locations.description:
**Requires**: _10 Rupees per game_

Talk to the Fisherman by the pond to try your hand at the fishing game. 

The minigame's three "special" catches become available after completing [Catfish's Maw](#loc=53775) (Cheep Cheep and Blooper) & the [Face Shrine](#loc=53774) (Ol' Baron).

**Lightweight Lure** is best used when trying to catch Little Fish & small Cheep Cheep at the surface of the pond.

The **Middleweight Lure** is received as a reward for catching a Big Fish for the first time. It descends faster to the middle than the Lightweight or heavyweight Lures. This is the best lure to use when trying to catch Big Fish & Bloopers in the middle of the pond.

The **Heavyweight Lure** is received as a reward for catching a Blooper for the first time. It descends faster to the bottom than the Lightweight or Middleweight Lures. This is the best lure to use when trying to catch Big Fish & Ol' Baron at the bottom of the pond.

locations.title: Chamber Dungeon
locations.description: Dampé and the Chamber Dungeon are new additions to the Nintendo Switch remake of Link's Awakening. The Chamber Dungeon minigame lets you assemble Chamber Stones (room pieces) to create custom dungeons. To find Chamber Stones, complete minigames, complete dungeons, or purchase them from shops.

locations.title: Rapids Raid
locations.description:
_100 rupees per game_

The Rapids Race is a water-based obstacle course you navigate by following current lines and a hookshot. Your rewards are based on how quickly you can finish the obstacle course. The finish line is the waterfall south of the rapids.

**Rewards:**
- Under 40 Seconds — Heart Piece
- Under 35 Seconds — Secret Seashell
- Under 30 Seconds — Chamber Stone

locations.title: Moldorm
locations.description:
_Dungeon Boss_

To damage Moldorm, hit the glowing red orb at the end of its tail. When you hit it, Moldorm will frantically move around the room and attack you. Be careful around the room's corners—Moldorm can push you into the holes, forcing you to navigate back to the Boss Room and restart the fight.

**Reward:** Heart Container

locations.title: Spike Roller
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

Use the Roc's Feather to jump over and avoid the spike pole that will roll across the room. Hit the Spike Roller with your sword.

locations.title: Hinox
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

The Hinox will throw bomb and charge at you, all in an attempt to grab and throw you for massive damage. Lure the Hinox to charge at you, but dodge so it hits the wall instead. The Hinox will stumble, giving Link an opportunity to do some damage.

locations.title: Genie
locations.description:
_Boss_

To damage the Genie, dodge the fireballs until you can get next to the Genie and hit him. When the Genie retreats into his bottle, use the [Power Bracelet](#loc=54046) to throw it. After three throws, the bottle will break. The Genie's fireball attack will change; now he goes transparent and then will randomly appear to throw one, massive fireball at Link. Dodge the fireball and get close to the Genie to land some hits.

**Reward:** Heart Container

locations.title: Dodongo Snakes
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

Dodongo Snakes open their mouth every time they move forward. Throw a bomb in front of them just before they move, and the snakes will eat the bomb. Don't try to immediately feed them a bomb again; the snakes need to move three blocks before they will eat another bomb.

locations.title: Slime Eye
locations.description:
_Dungeon Boss_

Every time you attack Slime Eye's eye, he divides further and further. When there nothing left but a small thread connecting the slime halves, use the Pegasus Boots to sever the connection. This create two smaller Slime Eyes. Attack their eyes and defeat the small Slime Eyes to defeat this boss.

**Reward:** Heart Container

locations.title: Master Stalfos #4 (Hookshot)
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

This is the fourth and last room you fight Master Stalfos.

To defeat Master Stalfos, guard with your shield until they swing at you with their sword. When Master Stalfos is recovering, his shield will be down and you can land a few hits. Unlike the other three fights, this time Master Stalfos will also perform a jump attack that will go through Link's shield. When Master Stalfos collapses into a pile of bones, drop a bomb on them. Repeat three times.

Master Stalfos will finally be defeated and drop the Hookshot that they stole!

locations.title: Master Stalfos #1
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

This is the first room you fight Master Stalfos.

To defeat Master Stalfos, guard with your shield until they swing at you with their sword. When Master Stalfos is recovering, his shield will be down and you can land a few hits. When Master Stalfos collapses into a pile of bones, drop a bomb on them. Repeat three times.

locations.title: Master Stalfos #2
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

This is the second room you fight Master Stalfos.

To defeat Master Stalfos, guard with your shield until they swing at you with their sword. When Master Stalfos is recovering, his shield will be down and you can land a few hits. When Master Stalfos collapses into a pile of bones, drop a bomb on them. Repeat three times.

locations.title: Master Stalfos #3
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

This is the third room you fight Master Stalfos.

To defeat Master Stalfos, guard with your shield until they swing at you with their sword. When Master Stalfos is recovering, his shield will be down and you can land a few hits. When Master Stalfos collapses into a pile of bones, drop a bomb on them. Repeat three times.

locations.title: Gohma
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

This is the "real" mini-boss of Catfish's Maw. 

The crab-like mini-boss has two primary attacks: a charge attack if Link is nearby, and a long-range fire attack if Link is far away. You want to stay far away and wait for the Gohma to open their eye to shoot fire. Shoot at the open eye with the Hookshot or Bow to stun the Gohma.

locations.title: Slime Eel
locations.description:
_Dungeon Boss_

The Slime Eel will burst through the room and create five holes: one hole for his mace-like tail to attack you, and four holes for his head to appear and shoot fire at you. When the Slime Eel appears at one of the wall holes and opens his mouth, use the Hookshot to pull the Slime Eel out of the hole. This will reveal his weak point: the large pink segment of his body. Hit the pink circle before the Slime Eel slowly falls back into the wall hole.

**Reward:** Heart Container

locations.title: Rover
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

Rover has a large ball that he will throw at Link. Before Rover can pick up the ball, steal it and throw it at him to do damage. Rover cannot be damaged by any other attacks.

locations.title: Facade
locations.description:
_Dungeon Boss_

The hardest part of this boss fight is avoiding all the obstacles that Facade throws at Link. Tiles will spin and fly at Link, and Facade will open up a trail of holes in the floor. While avoiding these, do your best to throw bombs on Facade's "face". 

**Reward:** Heart Container

locations.title: Dodongo Snakes
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

The Dodongo Snakes previously appeared in the Key Cavern. This time, you have to contend with holes in the floor while trying to lure the snakes to eat bombs.

locations.title: Hinox
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

The main attack of this mini-boss is to grab and throw Link. There are also four brasiers in the room that will shoot fire. Stay out of the Hinox's reach and use a long-range attack (bomb, boomerang, bow, hookshot) to deal damage.

locations.title: Grim Creeper
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

The Grim Creeper will stay on his raised platform and play a flute to summon Battle Bats (flying bombs). You must successfully hit each Battle Bat as it flies towards you without getting hit. If even a single Battle Bat hits you, then you have to start over.

locations.title: Grim Creeper & The Evil Eagle
locations.description:
_Dungeon Boss_

During your second encounter with the Grim Creeper, they bring a little more muscle: the Evil Eagle. 

Use your shield and run against the gusts of wind to protect Link from getting blown off the edge. When the Evil Eagle swoops over Link, use the Boomerang to land a few hits.

**Reward:** Heart Container

locations.title: Lanmola
locations.description:
_Overworld Boss_

The Lanmola is a centipede that prowls a quicksand pit in the Yarna Desert. Avoid the center of the quicksand pit while trying to land hits on Lanmola's head. 

**Reward:** [Angler Key](#loc=542860)

locations.title: Hydrosoar
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

 The Hydrosaur is an octopus-like enemy that charges down the sides of the room. Use Roc's Feather to jump over the charging enemy, causing it to crash into the wall and be temporarily stunned. Use this opportunity to land a few hits.

locations.title: Angler Fish
locations.description:
_Dungeon Boss_

Head down the stairs to enter an underground pool. Swim down to find the boss.

Avoid the Angler Fish and falling boulders while Link tries to land a few hits on the glowing orb attached to the boss. The boss will also summon smaller, mini-Angler fish that will swim straight for Link.

**Reward:** Heart Container

locations.title: Giant Buzz Blob
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

Use Magic Powder to make the green Giant Buzz Blob turn blue. Land a few hits before it turns back to green.

locations.title: Avalaunch
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

Every time Avalaunch jumps, boulders will fall into the room. Use Roc's Feather to jump and avoid the shockwaves, which would normally stun Link. Dodge the boulders to get close and land some hits on Avalaunch.

locations.title: Hardhit Beetle
locations.description:
_Dungeon Boss_

Every time you attack the Hardhit Beetle's shell, it changes color. When the shell turns red, it will finally crack and defeat the boss.

**Reward:** None

locations.title: Turtle Rock
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

Use the Ocarina to play Frog's Song of Soul to awaken Turtle Rock.

The stone turtle head will shake and lunge at Link. When the stone head hits the wall and stuns the creature, throw a bomb. After a few more bombs, the stone will finally crack and reveal the turtle head underneath.  From here, it's a normal boss fight: dodge the turtle's attacks and attack the turtle's head with your sword when you have an opening.

locations.title: Blue Hinox
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

This fight is exactly like the previous red Hinox that you fought, but the Blue Hinox deals more damage and has more health.

locations.title: Spike Roller
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

This is a repeat of your very first mini-boss from Tail Cave. Use Roc's Feather to jump over the rolling spike pole. Hit the Spike Roller with your sword when you have an opening.

locations.title: Rover
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

Rover returns with his iron ball. The mini-boss is the exact same as the last dungeon—pick up the iron ball before Rover can reach it, then throw it back at Rover.

locations.title: Blaino
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

Blaino is a boxing enemy, who attacks with quick jabs or charging punches. After a large charging punch, Blaino will pause for a moment and Link can attack.

locations.title: Hydrosoar
locations.description:
_Mini-Boss_

The Hydrosaur will charge along the wall edges like normal, but now Link has very little space to dodge its attacks. Be very careful with your jumps or you may land in the lava. Lure the Hydrosaur to crash into the walls and attack it when it's stunned.

locations.title: Hot Head
locations.description:
_Dungeon Boss_

Use the Magic Rod to hit Hot Head with fireballs when it jumps out of the lava. After enough hits, Hot Head will extinguish and become a solid rock that bounces around the room. Use your shield to block the attack. Hot Head will reignite, and you repeat the process with the Magic Rod.

**Reward:** Heart Container

locations.title: 20 Rupees
locations.description: Kill the nearby Mini-Moldorm for the treasure chest to appear.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description: Requires the [Power Bracelet](#loc=54046) to move the clay pots and reach this treasure chest.

locations.title: Power Bracelet
locations.description: Light the two torches in the room to scare off the Boos. When the boos disappear, a treasure chest will appear in the room. Open it to find the Power Bracelet.

locations.title: Slime (False Chest)
locations.description: If you open this chest, a Slime will pop out. There are no rewards for opening the chest or killing the slime.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description: Kill the enemies in this room for this treasure chest to appear on the raised platform.

locations.title: Pegasus Boots
locations.description: Open the treasure chest to gain the Pegasus Boots.

locations.title: 300 Rupees
locations.description: Unlike most chest where you clear a single room to spawn a chest, you must kill all enemies in all three rooms connected to this long hallway. Make sure to kill the enemies on both sides of the wall that bisects each room.

locations.title: 100 Rupees
locations.description:
**Required:** [Hookshot](#loc=55880)

Shoot the Hookshot at the treasure chest to cross the chasm and retrieve 100 Rupees.

locations.title: Hookshot (False Chest)
locations.description:
This is where the hookshot _should_ be, but Master Stalfos has stolen it.

You must defeat Master Stalfos four times, in a specific sequence of rooms to properly retrieve the Hookshot. Throughout the dungeon, you'll find empty rooms with green tiles that correspond to the order you fight Master Stalfos.
- [Room #1](#loc=55891)
- [Room #2](#loc=55927)
- [Room #3](#loc=55931)
- [Room #4](#loc=55880)

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description:
**Required:** [Hookshot](#loc=55880)

Shoot the Hookshot at the chest to cross the chasm and open it to receive some rupees.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description:
**Required:** [Hookshot](#loc=55880)

Shoot the Hookshot at the accordion platform to stretch it across the chasms. Ccross and open the treasure chest.

locations.title: Powerful Bracelet
locations.description: Open the treasure chest to find the Powerful Bracelet. As the name suggests, this is a more powerful version of the Power Bracelet. You can now lift the giant elephant statues scattered around the dungeon.

locations.title: Secret Medicine
locations.description: If you already have Secret Medicine in your inventory, then Link puts the item back and the treasure chest appears unopened from the map.

locations.title: Mirror Shield
locations.description: Open the treasure chest to retrieve the Mirror Shield, a very important upgrade.

locations.title: Secret Medicine
locations.description: If you already have Secret Medicine in your inventory, then Link puts the item back and the treasure chest appears unopened from the map.

locations.title: Flippers
locations.description: Open the treasure chest to find the Flippers. Link can now swim in deep water and dive underwater.

locations.title: 20 Rupees
locations.description: There is a glowing mechanism between the blocks. Attack the mechanism and use it to fill the floor's hole with stone. When the hole is completely filled, a treasure chest will appear.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description: Open the treasure chest to receive 50 rupees.

locations.title: Secret Medicine
locations.description: If you already have Secret Medicine in your inventory, then Link puts the item back and the treasure chest appears unopened from the map.

locations.title: Magic Rod
locations.description: Open the measure chest to receive the Magic Rod, a magical long-range weapon that shoots fireballs.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description:
**Requires**: Power Bracelet

Lift the boulder out of the way to get to the chest

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description: **Requires**: Hookshot

locations.title: 20 Rupees
locations.description:
**Required**: Roc's Feather

Jump over the gap to access the chest.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description:
**Required**: Power Bracelet

Lift the skull to access the chest.

locations.title: 20 Rupees
locations.description: Found while solving the puzzle to get the Heart Piece.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description:
**Requires**: Bombs, Pegasus Boots

In the cave leading to the Heart Piece.

locations.title: Slime Key
locations.description:
**Required**: [Deluxe Shovel](#loc=518631), Golden Leaves

Dig directly in front of the Owl Statue.

locations.title: Bombs
locations.description:
Available after Bottle Grotto.

Purchase 10 Bombs for 10 Rupees.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description:
**Requires**: Hookshot

In the same cave as the Heart Piece. Use your Hookshot to reach the chest.

locations.title: 100 Rupees
locations.description: Treasure Chest to the right of the Ocarina.

locations.title: 50 Rupees
locations.description:
**Requires**: Hookshot, Power Bracelet, Roc's Feather

Enter the cavern & go one screen right. Push the block into the pit then push the next block out of the way to reach the stairs. Walk to the right & climb up the stairs at the end. Use your Hookshot on the Treasure Chest to reach it.

Once opened push the boulder directly below & use Roc's Feather to jump back across.

locations.title: Deluxe Shovel
locations.description:
Available after you come back from your first visit to the Mysterious Forest at the beginning of the game.

Buy for 200 Rupees.

locations.title: Bow & Arrow Set
locations.description:
Can be purchased after you bought the Deluxe Shovel.

Buy for 980 Rupees.

locations.title: Ocarina
locations.description: At the end of the Dream Shrine to the left of the Treasure Chest.

locations.title: Chamber Stone
locations.description:
**Requires**: Beating the final boss & loading the completed save after the credits roll.

Collect all 11 figures from the Trendy Game.

**Note**: Doing this also reduces the cost of playing the game to 5 Rupees.

locations.title: Chamber Stone x 4
locations.description:
**Requires**: Completion of [Turtle Rock](#loc=53767)

Purchase each for 1,280 Rupees.

Need to exit & enter again for the next one to spawn.

locations.title: Seashell Sensor
locations.description: Reward for finding 15 Secret Seashells.

locations.title: Koholint Sword
locations.description: Reward for finding 40 Secret Seashells.

locations.title: Chamber Dungeon Modifier
locations.description: Find all 50 Secret Seashells.

locations.title: Chamber Stone
locations.description: Reward for finding 30 Secret Seashells.

locations.title: Chamber Stone
locations.description:
**Requires**: Hookshot, 100 Rupees

Complete the [Rapids Race](#loc=53826) in less than 30 seconds.

locations.title: Boomerang
locations.description:
**Requires**: Completion of the Trading Sequence (Magnifying Glass), Bombs, Hookshot

Place a bomb at the cracked wall to open up a cave entrance. The Magnifying Glass allows link to see & talk to Goriya who will trade whatever you have in your X or Y slot (Deluxe Shovel is probably best) for the Boomerang.

Immediately after you aquire the Boomerang talk to Goriya again & buy the Deluxe Shovel back for 300 Rupees.

locations.title: Chamber Stone
locations.description:
**Requires**: Completion of the Face Shrine (for Ol' Baron to spawn)

Obtained after catching an Ol' Baron fish over 150 centimeters (59.06 inches)

locations.title: Chamber Stone
locations.description:
**Requires**: Completion of the Face Shrine (for Ol' Baron to spawn)

When you catch your first Ol' Baron fish (any size) the Fisherman gives you a Chamber Stone.

locations.title: Heavyweight Lure
locations.description:
**Requires**: Completion of Catfish's Maw (for both fish to spawn)

Catch a Cheep Cheep or large Blooper fish.

locations.title: Angler Key
locations.description: Kill Lanmola w/ 8 slashes. The key is dropped when it is defeated.

locations.title: Pillar #4
locations.description:
In the room below on the south side defeat the Three-of-a-Kinds to spawn a Treasure Chest then toss the Large Ball north over the barrier.

Then work your way back to the room to the right of the floating tiles. Bomb the wall inbetween the two torches then follow the path down to another breakable wall. Use your hookshot to reach the Treasure Chest then carry the Large Ball up & destroy the last pillar.

locations.title: Pillar #3
locations.description: Use the Northwest entrance to the room & throw the ball over the barrier. Work your way back up from the 1st floor to reach it on the other side.

locations.title: Pillar #2
locations.description: Use the Large Ball to knock it down from its south side.

locations.title: Pillar #1
locations.description: Use the [Large Ball](#loc=542848) to the right to knock it down from its east side.

locations.title: Large Ball
locations.description:
Used to knock the four Pillars down.
- [Pillar #1](#loc=542847)
- [Pillar #2](#loc=542846)
- [Pillar #3](#loc=542845)
- [Pillar #4](#loc=542844)

locations.title: Blue Rooster
locations.description:
**Requires**: Ocarina (Song #3 - Frog’s Song of Soul), Powerful Bracelet

After completing the [Face Shrine](#loc=53774) use the **Powerful Bracelet** to push the statue to reveal a hidden staircase.

Use the **Ocarina** to play **Frog's Song of Soul** in front of the dead rooster bones to revive the **Blue Rooster**.

locations.title: Bird Key
locations.description:
**Requires**: Blue Rooster, Ocarina (Song #3 - Frog’s Song of Soul), Powerful Bracelet

After completing the [Face Shrine](#loc=53774) go to the **Giant Rooster Statue** in Mabe Village & push it to reveal a hidden staircase. Use the **Ocarina** to play **Frog's Song of Soul** & revive the **Blue Rooster**. 

Go to the cave & solve the rock puzzle to get to the other side. Use the **[Blue Rooster](#loc=542849)** to fly to the **Bird Key**.

locations.title: Ocarina Song #3 - Frog's Song of Soul
locations.description:
Completion of the Signpost Maze, Hookshot, Ocarina

After finishing the Maze go down the hidden steps & talk to Mamu. For 300 Rupees it will teach you the last song.

locations.title: Ocarina Song #2 - Manbo’s Mambo
locations.description:
**Required**: Flippers, Ocarina

After beating the Angler's Tunnel Dungeon head left from the entrance. The next cave opening leads to Manbo's Cave. He will teach you the song the first time you interact w/ him.

locations.title: Ocarina Song #1: Ballad of the Wind Fish
locations.description:
**Required**: Ocarina

(If you found the Ocarina before finding Animal Village Marin will be standing next to the Bird Statue north of Marin's House in Mabe Village.)

After leaving the Dream Shrine go to Marin's House & read the note saying she went to the beach. Find her, watch the cutscene, then take her to Animal Village. 

Walk over to the sleeping Walrus & talk to it triggering Marin to sing. When she is done find her in the center of Animal Village where she will teach you the first song.
